reviewerRubric.dualCoding: Separate reviewers must independently code original commitment, attempt, implementation, deadline and evidence; reconcile with adjudication log
reviewerRubric.effortIndex: Three applicable binary dimensions only. Unknown is null, not zero; inapplicable components must be excluded. Score is never an intent judgment.
reviewerRubric.executiveOrderDoesNotAutomaticallyImplyP: Executive order may fully satisfy an executive-action-specific pledge; judge against original promise's target and population
reviewerRubric.intentInference: Cannot infer deliberate deception from unified government and LEI=0; require direct contemporaneous evidence and competing-cause evaluation.
reviewerRubric.scoring: 3 full, 2 partial, 1 formal attempted, 0 exhaustively confirmed no formal attempt; unknown null
reviewerRubric.unattemptedRequiresExhaustiveReview: A missing row, unanswered query, or uncoded document cannot be an outcome 0

sourceCollectionRule.exclude: Generic non-testable rhetoric, post-election coalition agreements, duplicates, unapproved surrogate speeches
sourceCollectionRule.include: All authoritative campaign policy statements, platform and nominee convention speeches before election cutoff; fixed tier and catalog before evaluating outcomes
sourceCollectionRule.partyRules: 2020 Republicans explicitly did not adopt new 2020 platform; 2016 platform is a historically re-affirmed document, not newly authored 2020 text
